findings.claim: Remote digest trims contiguous trailing then leading characters from setSP/CR/LF, cuts32bytes, and compares case-sensitively via __mbscmp with local lowercase32hex. Local file wrapper reads1024byte chunks and formats16byte digest; initial state is MD5 constants. CString-copy helper0x407680 is not the hash algorithm.

First two stream tokens: URL1..255B and archive text1..31B at worker. Handoff builder requires decimal1..10digits, value1..268435456,32hex digest; URL HTTP/S prefix case-insensitive, rejectspipe/doublequote/control and requires first post-scheme character notslash/backslash/space. Remaining URI validity is delegated to transport. Locator text is preserved.

On current launcher, xml_md5.dat response goes to local temporary CString; success return gates GameList then RegionList GETs, bodies go to context+0xc/+0x10. Within full worker no catalog digest tokens or hash-based refresh selection are consumed. Subsequent staged files are validated/compared by stage91 callbacks.
